21	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
22	import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.util.IdentityKey;
23	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

25	/**
26	 * Detects whether a would-be owner duplicates an existing one. Duplication is decided by a
27	 * single derived {@link IdentityKey}: a candidate is a duplicate exactly when its whole
28	 * identity key equals that of some existing owner. This consolidates the former separate
29	 * telephone, email and household checks into one rule.
30	 */
31	@Component
32	public class IdentityDuplicateValidator {
33	
34	    /**
35	     * @param candidate the owner about to be created, with its telephone, email and household id
36	     *                  already in their canonical (stored) form
37	     * @param existingOwners owners already stored to compare against (a full-key match requires an
38	     *                       equal telephone, so callers typically pre-filter by telephone)
39	     * @return {@code true} when some existing owner shares the candidate's whole identity key
40	     */
41	    public boolean isDuplicate(Owner candidate, Collection<Owner> existingOwners) {
42	        String key = IdentityKey.of(candidate);
43	        return existingOwners.stream().anyMatch(existing -> IdentityKey.of(existing).equals(key));
44	    }
45	}

# Owner Registration / Duplicate Detection — Current Implementation

## Important framing note
The acceptance test at `AcceptanceTest.java` describes a **target "identity-key-v2"** design that is **NOT yet implemented**. Its Javadoc (lines 9-11) specifies `identityKey = SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName))` producing a lowercase 64-hex string. The **current** implementation produces a plain, un-hashed string `telephone|email|householdId` and there is **no soundex anywhere** (no `commons-codec`, no Soundex class). So the two acceptance tests would currently fail — this is the redesign you're being asked to do.

---

## 1. identityKey computation (current)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/IdentityKey.java` (lines 32-46)
```java
public final class IdentityKey {
    public static String of(Owner owner) {
        return orEmpty(owner.getTelephone()) + "|" + orEmpty(owner.getEmail()) + "|"
            + orEmpty(owner.getHouseholdId());
    }
    private static String orEmpty(String value) { return value == null ? "" : value; }
}
```
Key = `normalizedTelephone + "|" + email + "|" + householdId`. **Plain concatenation, no hashing.** Values are assumed already normalized (E.164 telephone, lower-cased email).

The SHA-256 helper exists but is used only for customerCode/householdId, NOT for the identity key:
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Sha256Hex.java` (lines 27-52) — `upperHexPrefix(String value, int length)`, upper-case hex.

The identityKey is exposed in the API response via the mapper:
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` line 43 (`@Mapping(target = "identityKey", expression = "java(formatIdentityKey(owner))")`) and lines 173-175 (`formatIdentityKey` → `IdentityKey.of(owner)`).

OpenAPI schema: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` lines 2204-2211 (documents current `<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>` format, example `+61412345678||3F2A9C1E7B4D`).

## 2. Duplicate detection returning HTTP 409

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/validation/IdentityDuplicateValidator.java` (lines 41-44)
```java
public boolean isDuplicate(Owner candidate, Collection<Owner> existingOwners) {

    return existingOwners.stream().anyMatch(existing -> IdentityKey.of(existing).equals(key));
}
```

Triggered in the controller `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`, `rejectIfDuplicateIdentity` (lines 336-342):

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for
            backward compatibility. On create it is normalized; when structured address
            fields are supplied it is returned as the composed addressLine1 (with a single
            space and addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when supplied (non-blank); normalized on create by the same rules
            as 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            supplied it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country
            code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The stored value is a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits and is returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be four digits and valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored
            and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to
            derive the owner's 'ageBand' against the registration date. Accepted and
            returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode); the owner is then created
            as a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it,
            such an owner is rejected as a household duplicate. Write-only hint used only on create;
            it is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title followed by a single space
                and the lastName when a title is present, or just the lastName when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes, e.g. '+61 412 345 678'. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F2A9C1E'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, e.g. 'NSW-3F2A9C1E-M27'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F2A9C1E-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the calendar year the fiscal year ends
                in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a registrationDate on or after 1 July falls
                in the next calendar year's fiscal year, e.g. a date in September 2026 yields 'FY27'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners in the same household. It is
                deterministic, being the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized last name concatenated with '|' and the postcode, so every owner with
                the same last name and postcode shares it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1E7B4D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used to detect duplicate owners, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners
                are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F2A9C1E7B4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last
                name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration date at the moment it was created, flagging a possible bulk signup;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0 plus 2 when an email is
                present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, and
                plus 3 when tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level derived from membershipPoints;
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more. A new owner joining
                an existing household is capped at one above the highest membershipLevel among the
                household members that existed when they were created; with no existing household
                member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region code derived from the postcode at creation), or
                'UNKNOWN' when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality (canonical
                region) via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has
                no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from its stored
                fields; 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from its birthDate against the
                registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing
                owner's last name and postcode while having a different telephone, flagging a
                possible duplicate at the moment it was created; otherwise false. An owner created
                as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of; absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; deleting an owner sets it true while retaining the record, and the create
                endpoint's duplicate and identity checks then ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I redesigned the identity key and duplicate/soft-match logic to match the specification. All 5 tests pass (including the two acceptance tests that were previously failing).

### Changes

**`util/Soundex.java`** (new) — American Soundex encoder (`first letter + 3 digits`), with the standard H/W-transparent, vowel-resetting rules. Single responsibility: phonetic surname coding.

**`util/Sha256Hex.java`** — added `lowerHex(String)` returning the full 64-char lower-case SHA-256 digest, reusing the existing private `sha256` helper (the old `upperHexPrefix` for customer code / household id is untouched).

**`util/IdentityKey.java`** — `of(owner)` now returns `Sha256Hex.lowerHex(normalizedTelephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + Soundex.encode(lastName))`. The household id is no longer part of identity. Email is lower-cased defensively; telephone is used in its stored E.164 form.

**`rest/validation/PossibleDuplicateDetector.java`** — soft match now triggers when the **identity key differs** but **Soundex(lastName)** and **postcode** match (previously: same last name, same postcode, *different telephone*). It still returns the lowest-id match and skips when postcode is absent.

**Docs** — updated the `identityKey` OpenAPI schema description/example, plus the javadocs on `IdentityKey`, `IdentityDuplicateValidator`, and `PossibleDuplicateDetector` to describe the new key.

### Behaviour delivered
- **409 duplicate detection** uses the single SHA-256 identity key, still filtering out soft-deleted owners (`activeOwners`) and still applying the disposable-email-domain blocklist first (`addOwner` order unchanged). The telephone pre-filter in `rejectIfDuplicateIdentity` remains valid since an equal key implies an equal telephone.
- **Same lastName + postcode, different telephone** → no longer a hard duplicate; created as a **soft match** (their keys differ but Soundex + postcode match).
- **Household-duplicate 409** from the computed `householdId` is gone from identity — it was already never thrown, and household id no longer participates in the key, so duplicate detection is now the single identity key.

I kept each piece in its own small unit (encoding in `Soundex`, hashing in `Sha256Hex`, key derivation in `IdentityKey`, soft-match rule in `PossibleDuplicateDetector`) rather than expanding the controller.
